# FactoryLM

> An equipment notebook for maintenance crews. Not a CMMS. No PLC data, no work-order writes.

## Who it's for

- Mike can come onsite in Central Florida or work remote.

## What we can show today

- Tested on a Rockwell Micro810 manual (same question 5 times, 5 correct answers citing the same page, Oct 19, 2026). That is a narrow test, not a general accuracy rate.
- We've tested Rockwell and Festo manuals so far, and we'll post our misses too.
- Sign in with an emailed link, no password.

## What it does not do

- It's not a CMMS and doesn't replace yours. There's nothing to switch.
- It doesn't take PLC data and doesn't write work-order records.

## Prices

None are published. Talk to Mike: mike@factorylm.com
